title: Open3DCalc Data Manifest (SPEC-01)
description: Versioned, per-key/surface/platform data manifest. Normative contract for D1.1+. Each entry MUST define key, surface, platforms, and per-key policies (persistence, sync, export, erasure, retention) as INDEPENDENT fields; unknown keys MUST be denied (default-deny); plaintext_allowed MUST be valid only for pii:false keys.

manifest_version.description: Schema version of the manifest itself. Bump on any structural change.

policy_version.description: Version of the policy content. Referenced by consent receipts (SPEC-04 policy_hash).

surface.description: Physical persistence surface. Erasure (SPEC-02) iterates over these.

platform.description: Platform where this key exists. 'web' and 'pwa' may overlap; list each explicitly.

persistenceMode.description: At-rest policy. INDEPENDENT of sync/export/erasure. plaintext_allowed is only valid when pii is false (enforced by allOf constraint on manifestEntry).

syncMode.description: Cross-device sync policy (dataSync bundle). INDEPENDENT of persistence/export.

exportMode.description: Egress policy. user_export = SPEC-03 envelope only (ADR-003). diagnostic_only = engineering backup under ADR-003 §2.2. INDEPENDENT of persistence/sync.

erasureMode.description: Behavior under delete-all (SPEC-02). retain_anonymized requires a documented anonymization that removes PII per this manifest's pii flags.

max_days.description: Upper bound in days. 0 = no persistence beyond session. user_controlled = kept until the user deletes (delete-all / erasure saga).

key.description: Storage key (localStorage key name, SQLite storage-table key, table name, or file glob). Must be unique across the manifest.

class.description: Data class. onboarding_flag/consent_record are NEVER consent substitutes (SPEC-04).

pii.description: True if the value can contain personal data (directly or via snapshot blobs). Governs ADR-001/ADR-002 at-rest policy.

purpose.description: Why this data exists (LGPD finalidade). One sentence.

legal_basis.description: LGPD art. 7 legal basis. not_personal_data only valid when pii is false (enforced by constraint).

owner.description: Owning role for this entry (see OWNERS-RUNBOOK).

version.description: Entry version; bump when policy for this key changes.

then.description: plaintext_allowed is valid ONLY for non-PII keys. Zero plaintext PII path (ADR-001).
PII keys can never be plaintext_allowed. (Export modes listed for completeness; ADR-003 governs which flows may use diagnostic_only.)
Flags and consent records are local-only, never synced/exported, and never satisfy consent (SPEC-04).
Consent records themselves are non-PII local state; they must be erasable and must never leave the device.
Erasure snapshots (SPEC-02) are encrypted with TTL, never synced/exported, destroyed after commit.
Ephemeral keys (passphrase-derived session keys) live in memory only (ADR-001).
Diagnostics may only egress via the engineering path (ADR-003 §2.2), never user_export.
